_comment: Game-side variant rotation table (v1.1, 2026-08-19) — the audio bridge translates each listed sim event into one synthetic cue event per fire (deterministic no-immediate-repeat rotation; replay- and netplay-stable because both derive from the same event stream). The library sees only ordinary cue rows keyed on the synthetic names; this file is bridge custody, never loaded by AudioData. music_rotation (ambient v2, DORMANT 2026-08-20 — ask 8's evolving 64 s loop replaced the family rotation; re-add the block to reactivate): every period_ticks while the last-requested music state is in states[], the bridge requests the rotor's next pick (deterministic, no-immediate-repeat); combat entry pauses rotation naturally (last state leaves the family).
